vellum_obligation: A Vellum host that mirrors gpu_surface_dawn.cpp, gpu_surface.hpp, skia_surface.cpp and skia_surface.hpp keeps GpuSurface::resize() and SkiaSurface::resize() free of GPU work and lets begin_frame() configure the swapchain and size the Graphite targets once per frame; a host that reads the presented size between a resize and the next frame reads it from the acquired texture, not from width()/height().
